title: Billing cost-estimate transfer lookup requires a permission demo.billing does not have
actual: cost_estimates_billing lists GET /admissions/{admission_id}/transfers for the ChangeOfWard estimate. demo.billing has estimate.view/prepare/explain but not ipd.admission.view, and the lookup returns403 FORBIDDEN. Its worklist is authorised and carries a pending move's transfer_id, but selecting/reviewing the recorded moves through the listed endpoint is unavailable.
expected: Provide an estimate-scoped authorised transfer lookup, or define how Billing should obtain the recorded move using its estimate permissions without clinical chart access. Keep permissions enforced; do not require a typed or guessed transfer id.
steps: Read current cost_estimates_billing bundle/endpoints and demo.billing auth/me. Create own synthetic ipd.admission_pending scenario ae4ad2 (patient6/ticket5/admission7), then GET /admissions/7/transfers as demo.billing.
